config_yaml:
# Phase 3 functional smoke test: plumbing only, not a performance comparison.
# Every run embeds this file and its SHA-256 in its results.
name: phase3-smoke
gpu: L4  # smoke GPU per CLAUDE.md; performance comparisons use L40S
model:
  id: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
  revision: c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca  # resolved 2026-09-23
workload:
  input_tokens: 512
  output_tokens: 32
  concurrency: 4
  warmup_requests: 4
  measured_requests: 16
  timeout_s: 120
  seed: 20260923
vllm:
  image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.10.2@sha256:607442e407b0fea97f8a132a78b787c121a996dd4de181fa08e8da06e71ec2db
  health_timeout_s: 600
  engine_args:
    - --dtype
    - bfloat16
    - --max-model-len
    - "1024"
    - --gpu-memory-utilization
    - "0.85"
    - --max-num-seqs
    - "256"
    - --seed
    - "0"
    - --enforce-eager  # bounds smoke startup; performance runs will use CUDA graphs
    - --no-enable-prefix-caching
    - --generation-config
    - vllm  # ignore the checkpoint's sampling defaults
    - --disable-uvicorn-access-log
hf:
  dtype: bfloat16
  attn_implementation: sdpa
  health_timeout_s: 300
  modes:
    - mode: naive
    - mode: static
      batch_size: 4  # smoke coverage only; the Phase 6 size comes from an OOM probe
      batch_wait_ms: 50
label: vllm
